description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Ingus)], [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] and [Solid Guardian] to the user

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Ingus)
description.text: Earth abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 2 additional times

description.name: Solid Guardian
description.text: Grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering two times, grants [Buff Earth 20% (15s)] to all allies when removed, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Ingus)]

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Earth Mode II (Ingus)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Earth Mode I (Ingus)] and [Solid Guardian] from the user
